featured_reviews.review_text:
A Great Institution with Room for Improvement. My experience has been largely positive. This institution offers a robust academic environment, dedicated faculty, and a vibrant campus life that makes it a commendable choice for students pursuing higher education.

One of the standout features of College is its dedicated and experienced faculty. The professors are knowledgeable and passionate about their subjects, providing students with a strong academic foundation. Their commitment to teaching and willingness to support students both inside and outside the classroom create a nurturing learning environment.

The college offers a diverse range of programs and courses, catering to various academic interests and career aspirations. The curriculum is well-structured, balancing theoretical knowledge with practical application, which is crucial for students' overall development and future career prospects.

The campus itself is well-maintained and provides a pleasant atmosphere for studying and socializing. The classrooms are equipped with modern amenities, and the library is well-stocked with a wide variety of books and resources that support the students' academic needs. Additionally, the availability of computer labs and other facilities ensures that students have access to the tools they need for their studies.

One of the highlights of College is its vibrant campus life. The college hosts numerous cultural, sports, and academic events throughout the year, providing students with ample opportunities to explore their interests and talents outside the classroom. These activities foster a sense of community and help in the holistic development of students.

The administration at College is generally efficient and supportive. They are approachable and responsive to students' concerns, which helps in creating a smooth and hassle-free academic experience. However, there is always room for improvement in streamlining certain administrative processes to make them more student-friendly.

While my overall experience has been positive, there are a few areas where College could improve. Firstly, enhancing the infrastructure further, especially in terms of classroom technology and seating arrangements, would greatly benefit the students. Secondly, expanding the scope of extracurricular activities and providing more support for student-led initiatives could enhance the overall student experience.

In summary, Acharya College in Chembur is a great institution that offers quality education, dedicated faculty, and a vibrant campus life. With some improvements in infrastructure and administrative processes, it has the potential to become an even more outstanding institution. I highly recommend it to prospective students seeking a well-rounded college experience.

My college has always stood out because of its strong infrastructure and well-planned campus environment. From spacious classrooms to well-equipped labs, everything is designed to make the learning experience smooth and productive. The campus atmosphere is clean, disciplined, and student-friendly. One thing I really appreciate about the college is the variety of events and activities it organizes throughout the year. Large festivals, technical events, cultural programs, and guest sessions with well-known personalities make the environment lively and inspiring. These events don’t just entertain students—they help us grow, network, and learn beyond the syllabus. The placement opportunities provided are also helpful for students who want to start their career right after graduation.

If there is one challenge, it is the college’s distance from the nearest station. Traveling daily can be tiring for many students because of the long commute. The canteen also has scope for improvement. But apart from these minor issues, the overall experience is truly valuable. The college has given me strong academic knowledge, great memories, and a sense of confidence for the future. I genuinely believe it’s a great place for students who want quality education and a supportive environment.

I completed my graduation from this college between 2021 and 2023. During my time here, I observed that the staff and teaching staff lacked professionalism .They would say anything to students without any consideration. The rules and regulations were very strict, but ironically, there was no discipline.

When I finished my bachelor's degree, I visited the college to collect my mark sheet and results. I went to the office and asked the staff what documents I needed to submit to get my mark sheet. They asked me to bring my 5th-semester mark sheet.

The next day, I went back to the college, and the staff told me to clear any pending fees or issues from the office or library before they could give me my mark sheet. I did as they asked, but they kept asking me for more documents, including stamps.

Finally, they told me that my f.y. b.com fees were pending, which was not possible since I had always paid my fees on time. I showed them the receipts, but they refused to believe me. They demanded that I pay the fees again, which I didn't owe.

It was frustrating and disappointing to see how they handled the situation. They seemed more interested in getting the money than in helping me. For them, ₹4640 might not be a big amount, but for me, as a middle-class student, it mattered a lot. If i didn't have fees receipt i would have been forced to pay the fees otherwise they are not giving me Marksheet.  i informed that to my class teacher and principal about this issue , but they didn't respond or take any action .

This experience left a bad impression on me about the college's administration and their priorities.

Very nice. I studied there from 2015-2017.
At first I was very scared about this college, thinking how will be the teachers there, etc. As my friends were saying that college is not good.
But when I started going to that college, it was very nice. Teachers were soo polite, soo friendly and vvvv helpful.
I still remember, when I was not well (vomiting, etc) our physics mam (Inu bansal mam) used to get very tensed. Ya she is very strict but she is more friendly. I don't know whether now she is there or transferred. But she was very polite.
Our chemistry mam (Sangeeta sohni mam) was also good. She is also very nice.
My overall teachers were good.

I still remember. I had not prepared anything for board exams. And I got vv less marks in physics on 2nd prelims which has conducted just before one month for our hsc board exam. I don't remember the date but it was 1st week of jan or something. My physics mam meet me personally with my parents and suggested me how to study to crack board exam, which helped me a lot.

I also still remember that funny moment. Before board exam our biology mam (Sanghamitra mam) called me for extra classes. Then our chemistry mam entered the room where my biology teacher used to conduct classes. Then she started calling me and one of my friend to her extra classes. Now in chemistry extra classes our maths teacher (Omita mandal mam) came and started yelling us why we r nt attending extra classes. That moment was very funny. I used to hide my face when she comes and asks my other friend who is she and then they says "pratiksha" and then she also calls me for extra class. Even after biology and chemistry extra classes I was very exhausted so I and one of my frnd wanted to go home after that but then suddenly maths teacher came and called 4 extra classes, I hide my face. She asked who is she and my friend said it's me. Then both of us went for her extra classes.
For biology extra classes, we went to chemistry and maths classes. That moment was very funny and vvvvv useful.

I also missed some funny moments. Our english class was a funny class. Our english sir ( Sudhir khullar sir) was very nice, and he was as funny as strict. He had also helped me a lot to do well in my board exam. Our hindi sir (Tiwari sir) also helped me a lot.
Another funny moment was our chemistry practical class when I was in 11th. I don't remember her name but she was also very nice. And during practical classes she used to beat us in scale. Even I also got beaten up by her because I gave my practical book to one of my friend. But she was very nice.

If a student want to pass his/her 12th HSC board then this is the best college.
AEJC is best for those students who wants to study 12th hsc. This college will help you a lot.
